summary: Dedicated childcare worker with 10 years of continuous full-time experience in early childhood and school-age settings. Skilled in maintaining safe play environments, supporting social-emotional development, and keeping detailed records on daily activities and care.

experience.title: Lead Childcare Worker
experience.employer: a well-established local early learning center
bullets: Maintain a safe play environment for up to 18 children, completing safety checks on indoor and outdoor areas at the start of each shift.
Observe and monitor children's play activities, documenting developmental milestones and behavioral observations for each child daily.
Communicate with guardians about daily activities, behaviors, and related issues through written daily reports and brief in-person updates.
Support children's emotional and social development, encouraging understanding of others and positive self-concepts during group activities.
Sanitize toys and play equipment on a rotating schedule, reducing reported illness-related absences among enrolled children.
Keep records on individual children, including daily observations and information about activities, meals served, and medications administered.

experience.title: Childcare Worker
bullets: Cared for children in a nursery school setting, supervising classrooms of 12 to 16 children during structured and free-play periods.
Dressed children and changed diapers as needed, maintaining hygiene routines and respectful, individualized care.
Observed and monitored children's play activities to identify emerging social or emotional needs and adapt activities accordingly.
Sanitized toys and play equipment daily, following health and safety protocols.
Supported children's emotional and social development by modeling cooperative play and conflict-resolution language.
Kept records on individual children, including daily observations, meals served, and any medications administered.

experience.title: Assistant Childcare Worker
experience.employer: a well-established local employer childcare program
bullets: Maintained a safe play environment for children in an employer-sponsored childcare program serving staff on site.
Communicated with guardians about daily activities and behaviors during drop-off and pick-up.
Observed and monitored children's play activities across mixed-age groups, redirecting unsafe behavior promptly.
Dressed children and changed diapers, coordinating routines with co-workers to keep care consistent.
Sanitized toys and play equipment after each session to meet program health standards.
Supported children's emotional and social development, encouraging positive self-concepts and understanding of others.

experience.title: Childcare Aide
experience.employer: a local group home and daycare center
bullets: Cared for children in an institutional setting, assisting with daily routines in a group home and daycare center.
Maintained a safe play environment and monitored children's play activities indoors and outdoors.
Kept records on individual children, including daily observations and information about activities and meals served.
Sanitized toys and play equipment regularly to support a healthy environment.
Supported children's emotional and social development through one-on-one attention and group activities.
Communicated with guardians about daily activities and behaviors at the end of each day.

education.degree: Associate of Applied Science in Early Childhood Education
